title: KL Before and After Mixing: A Round-Complexity Separation in Parallel Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.13924v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A parallel sampler can choose at random which coordinates to generate together. For a target $p$ and the output law $q_U$ of a schedule $U$ drawn afresh for each output, we compare the schedule-averaged divergence $\mathbb{E}_U D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|q_U)$ with the output-law divergence $D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|\mathbb{E}_U q_U)$, in nats. Rounds commit independent draws from exact conditional marginals frozen at the round's start, each output's schedule is drawn before sampling from a finite mixture of schedules, and every scheduled round is charged. For the uniform distribution on binary strings of even length $n$ with $n/2$ ones, the least expected number of rounds at a fixed tolerance $\varepsilon>0$ is $\Theta_\varepsilon((\log n)^2)$ under the first criterion but $(e^{-\varepsilon}+o(1))\log_2\ln n$ under the second, and the double-logarithmic order is attainable with the same round count on every run. translated_title: 混合前后的KL散度：并行采样中的轮数复杂度分离
translated_abstract: 并行采样器可以随机选择将哪些坐标一起生成。对于目标分布 $p$ 以及为每次输出重新抽取的调度 $U$ 所对应的输出分布 $q_U$，我们比较（以奈特为单位）调度平均散度 $\mathbb{E}_U D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|q_U)$ 与输出分布散度 $D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|\mathbb{E}_U q_U)$。每轮从轮次开始时冻结的精确条件边缘分布中进行独立抽取，每次输出的调度在采样前从调度的有限混合中抽取，并且每个被调度的轮次均被计入成本。对于长度为偶数 $n$ 且恰有 $n/2$ 个 1 的二进制串上的均匀分布，在固定容差 $\varepsilon>0$ 下，第一种准则所需的最少期望轮数为 $\Theta_\varepsilon((\log n)^2)$，而第二种准则下仅为 $(e^{-\varepsilon}+o(1))\log_2\ln n$；并且这一双重对数阶可在每次运行中以相同的轮数实现。对于该目标分布，一个基于计数状态的递归……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了并行采样中两种KL散度准则之间的轮数复杂度分离：在均衡二进制串的均匀分布上，按调度平均散度准则需要 $\Theta((\log n)^2)$ 轮，而按输出分布散度准则仅需双重对数阶（约 $\log_2\ln n$）轮。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a round-complexity separation between schedule-averaged and output-law KL divergence criteria in parallel sampling: for the uniform distribution on balanced binary strings, the former criterion requires $\Theta((\log n)^2)$ rounds while the latter needs only $(e^{-\varepsilon}+o(1))\log_2\ln n$ rounds.
